name: cascade_delete
description: In main.go, the DELETE /api/customers/:c_custkey handler explicitly deletes child rows with `DELETE FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = ?` before deleting the parent customer. This matches the unsafe delete cascade signal because the GET /api/orders endpoint reads from `orders` via `FROM orders o JOIN customer c ...`, so deleting a customer permanently removes that customer's orders and causes that read endpoint to return missing/incomplete data.
